CREATE PROCEDURE DW.SP_DimRiskRating
AS BEGIN

WITH DIMRISKRATING AS (
        SELECT
        BCR.CreditRiskId AS RiskRatingID
        ,BCR.CreditRiskName AS RiskRatingName
        ,NULL AS RiskRatingDescription
        ,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
        ,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
        ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
        ,BCR.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
        FROM
        BNKM.CreditRisk BCR
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCR.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
        WHERE BCR.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'

        UNION

        SELECT
         BCA.RiskRating AS RiskRatingID
        ,BCA.RiskRating AS RiskRatingName
        ,NULL AS RiskRatingDescription
        ,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
        ,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
        ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
        ,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
        FROM 
        BNKM.CreditCardApplication BCA
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID

        UNION

        SELECT DISTINCT
        BSC.RiskClass AS RiskRatingID
        ,BSC.RiskClass AS RiskRatingName
        ,NULL AS RiskRatingDescription
        ,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
        ,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
        ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
        ,BSC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
        FROM
        BNKM.SecuritiesCustomer BSC
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BSC.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
)


,RISKRATINGSK AS (
    --SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SOURCESYSTEMCODE) RiskRatingSK, * FROM DIMRISKRATING
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(RISKRATINGSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimRiskRating
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING
AS(
    SELECT   
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM RISKRATINGSK) AS RiskRatingSK
    ,RiskRatingID
    ,RiskRatingName
    ,RiskRatingDescription
    ,BankSK
    ,ValidStartDate
    ,validEndDate
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm 
FROM DIMRISKRATING
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING FROM TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     RiskRatingID
    ,RiskRatingName
    ,RiskRatingDescription
    ,BankSK
    )) HASHROW, RiskRatingID,BankSK 
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     RiskRatingID
    ,RiskRatingName
    ,RiskRatingDescription
    ,BankSK
    )) HASHROW, RiskRatingID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimRiskRating WHERE ValidEndDate = '9999-12-31' 
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.RiskRatingID,TGT.RiskRatingID) AS RiskRatingID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.RiskRatingID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.RiskRatingID = TGT.RiskRatingID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.RiskRatingID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
FROM DW.DimRiskRating TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RiskRatingID = TGT.RiskRatingID  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING SRC ON SRC.RiskRatingID = TGT.RiskRatingID AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
WHERE TGT.ValidEndDate = '9999-12-31' ;


INSERT INTO DW.DimRiskRating ([RiskRatingSK]
,[RiskRatingID]
,[RiskRatingName]
,[RiskRatingDescription]
,[BankSK]
,[ValidStartDate]
,[ValidEndDate]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])
SELECT
     RiskRatingSK
    ,SRC.RiskRatingID
    ,RiskRatingName
    ,RiskRatingDescription
    ,SRC.BankSK
    ,ValidStartDate
    ,validEndDate
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm 
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATING_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RiskRatingID = SRC.RiskRatingID  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
